document_data.author: Nurse - Dr. Samuel Osei's Team
document_data.content:
MEDICATION UPDATE - RHEUMATOLOGY FOLLOW-UP

Date: 2026-10-05 (per Dr. Alvarez rheumatology follow-up note)

Medication changes per Rheumatology recommendations:

1. Hydroxychloroquine: INCREASED FROM 200mg to 400mg daily
   - Rationale: Per symptom report and disease control needs

2. Prednisone: REMAINS 5mg

3. Methotrexate: NEWLY INITIATED - 25mg weekly (take day)
   - Note: Patient had prior Hepatotoxicity with Methotrexate (discontinued 2021-03-05)
   - Hepatology clearance required prior to re-initiation
   - Close monitoring of liver function tests recommended

RATIONALE: Recent rheumatology follow-up recommends re-starting Methotrexate for disease control and increasing Hydroxychloroquine dosage based on symptom report.

PRECAUTIONS: Patient has history of severe hepatotoxicity with Methotrexate requiring hepatology consultation before re-initiation. Monitor LFTs closely.

NEXT FOLLOW-UP: Re-evaluate efficacy and tolerability.
